title: 第五章 崖底惊魂逢古洞第六章 石壁斑驳藏玄机
content_zh:
“我该怎么办…”
“我还能…怎么办…”
楚夜嘶哑的、如同梦呓般的低语，被黑风崖口呼啸的阴风瞬间撕碎、吞噬。最后一口混着血泪的劣酒灌入喉咙，带来的不是灼烧的暖意，而是更深、更冷的绝望。他颓然靠在冰冷的巨石上，感觉最后一丝支撑自己的力气也被抽空了。身体像一具被敲碎了骨头的破麻袋，每一寸都在**，每一处伤口都在散发着灼痛和寒意。视线开始模糊，黑暗如同粘稠的墨汁，从四面八方涌来，要将他彻底淹没。
背上的柳氏，气息微弱得几乎断绝，身体冰冷得没有一丝活气。
“娘…”楚夜艰难地侧过头，想最后看一眼母亲。视线却猛地定格在柳氏垂落的手腕上——那里，一道细小的、几乎看不清的伤口，正缓缓渗出一丝暗红色的血珠。伤口很新，边缘还带着摩擦的痕迹，显然是在他一路攀爬、摔倒时，被尖锐的岩石划破的。
就在那滴暗红的血珠，即将滴落在身下冰冷岩石的刹那——
嗡！！！
一声远比之前任何一次都要清晰、都要沉重、仿佛来自远古洪荒、带着开天辟地般威压的恐怖嗡鸣，猛地从楚夜后背脊骨深处炸响！
这一次，不再是沉闷的震动！而是如同洪钟大吕，直接在他濒临崩溃的识海深处轰鸣！楚夜浑身剧震，眼前瞬间被一片混沌的、充斥着毁灭雷霆和狂暴气流的虚空景象充斥！那片虚空中，那个无法形容其巨大的、由破碎星辰和扭曲法则构成的恐怖巨影，仿佛被这滴至亲之血彻底惊醒！
那双吞噬一切光线的混沌漩涡之眼，猛地转向楚夜意识的方向！一股无法形容的、狂暴到极点的吸力，混合着滔天的愤怒和不甘，如同跨越时空的锁链，猛地缠绕住楚夜的灵魂，狠狠一拽！
“呃啊——！”
现实中的楚夜发出一声不似人声的痛苦嘶吼！他感觉自己的灵魂像是要被硬生生从身体里扯出去！与此同时，后背那块沉寂的“废骨”，骤然爆发出难以想象的高温！皮肤下的青黑色纹路瞬间浮现，如同活物般疯狂扭曲、蔓延，散发出刺目的暗沉光芒！一股沛然莫御的、充满混沌与毁灭气息的恐怖力量洪流，轰然从脊骨深处爆发，瞬间冲向他枯竭的四肢百骸！
但这股力量，并非为了毁灭他！它在楚夜体内疯狂奔涌一周后，竟猛地透体而出，化作一股无形的、沉重如山岳般的恐怖威压，瞬间笼罩了以楚夜为中心的数丈方圆！这股威压带着一种至高无上的、源自生命本源的恐怖意志，霸道地排斥着周围的一切！包括那翻滚着、正缓缓向他们母子二人侵蚀而来的灰黑色死亡毒雾！
嗤嗤嗤！
如同滚烫的烙铁按在冰块上！那股无形的威压与灰黑色毒雾接触的瞬间，毒雾竟发出刺耳的腐蚀声响，如同活物般剧烈地翻滚、退缩！硬生生在楚夜和柳氏周围，撑开了一个直径约莫三尺的、暂时安全的“真空”地带！
“噗！”楚夜再次喷出一大口鲜血，颜色暗沉近黑！强行引导这股恐怖力量外放，对他本就重伤濒死的身体造成了更可怕的反噬！他感觉五脏六腑都移了位，全身的经脉都在哀嚎、崩裂！意识如同风中残烛，随时会彻底熄灭！
但那股源自混沌道骨的恐怖意志，却如同被点燃的荒古凶兽，在撑开安全地带后，并未收回！它仿佛被柳氏手腕上那滴至亲之血彻底激怒，带着一种近乎本能的、守护至亲的狂暴意念，猛地锁定了前方那翻滚的、蕴含着“死亡”与“腐朽”本源的毒雾深渊！
“吼——！”
一声只有楚夜灵魂能“听”到的、充满无尽威严与暴怒的混沌咆哮，在他识海中炸响！
紧接着，那股透体而出的恐怖威压，骤然化作一只无形的、由狂暴混沌气流凝聚而成的巨大“手掌”，带着碾碎星辰、撕裂虚空的恐怖气势，朝着前方翻滚的毒雾深渊，狠狠一抓！

轰隆隆！！！
整个黑风崖口仿佛都震动了一下！那浓稠如墨的灰黑色毒雾，如同被投入巨石的死水潭，猛地炸开！一个直径足有丈许的巨大漩涡瞬间形成，漩涡中心，翻滚的毒雾被那股霸道绝伦的混沌之力硬生生排开、湮灭！一条笔直的、通往深渊之下的通道，竟被这蛮横无比的一“抓”，强行撕开！
通道内壁翻滚着残余的毒雾，发出不甘的嘶嘶声，却无法再靠近通道分毫！通道下方，一片深不见底的黑暗，散发着令人心悸的阴冷气息，隐约还有某种沉闷的、如同巨兽心跳般的搏动声传来！
这通道，只维持了短短一息！
那股强行爆发、排斥毒雾、撕开通道的恐怖力量，如同昙花一现，在撕开通道的瞬间便耗尽了所有威能，潮水般缩回了楚夜的脊骨深处！笼罩在周围的威压瞬间消失，那三尺的安全地带也迅速被重新涌来的毒雾吞噬！
噗通！
力量抽离带来的巨大空虚感和更猛烈的反噬，让楚夜再也支撑不住，眼前彻底一黑，身体像断线的木偶般，直挺挺地向前扑倒！而他倒下的方向，正是那条被混沌之力强行撕开、正在迅速闭合的毒雾通道！
“娘——！”
在意识彻底陷入黑暗前的最后一瞬，楚夜用尽灵魂最后的力量嘶吼一声，双手本能地、死死地抱住了身边柳氏冰冷瘫软的身体！
下一刻，两人的身影，如同被黑暗巨口吞噬的尘埃，猛地坠入了那条正在急速缩小的、翻滚着死亡毒雾的深渊通道！
呼呼呼——！
耳边是急速下坠带来的、如同鬼哭般的风声！身体被翻滚的、残余的毒雾气流撕扯着，冰冷刺骨，带着强烈的腐蚀性！皮肤传来针扎般的刺痛！楚夜早已昏迷，只有残存的本能，让他死死地抱着怀里的母亲，用自己的身体尽可能将她护住。
下坠！无休止的下坠！
时间仿佛失去了意义。只有那令人心悸的失重感和越来越浓的、令人窒息的腐朽气息。
不知过了多久，仿佛只是一瞬，又仿佛过了万年。
砰！哗啦！
content_en:
"What should I do..."
"What else can I do..."
Chu Ye's hoarse, sleep-like whisper was instantly torn apart and swallowed up by the howling wind at the mouth of the black wind cliff. The last mouthful of bad wine mixed with blood and tears poured down his throat, bringing not burning warmth, but a deeper and colder despair. He leaned slumped against the cold boulder, feeling that the last bit of strength holding him up was drained away. The body was like a broken sack with broken bones, every inch was swollen, and every wound was exuding burning pain and chill. His vision began to blur, and darkness was like thick ink, coming from all directions, trying to completely submerge him.
Liu's breath on his back was so weak that it was almost cut off, and his body was so cold that there was no trace of vitality.
"Mother..." Chu Ye turned his head with difficulty, wanting to take one last look at his mother. But his eyes suddenly fixed on Liu's hanging wrist - there was a small, almost invisible wound, and a trace of dark red blood was slowly oozing out. The wound was very new, and there were still traces of friction on the edges. It was obviously scratched by sharp rocks when he climbed and fell.
At the moment when the drop of dark red blood was about to fall onto the cold rock beneath him——
Buzz! ! !
A horrifying buzz that was far clearer and heavier than any before, as if it came from ancient times, and carried the pressure of the beginning of the world, suddenly exploded from the depths of Chu Ye's back and spine!
This time, it’s no longer a dull shock! Instead, it was like Hong Zhong Da Lu, roaring directly in the depths of his sea of ​​consciousness that was on the verge of collapse! Chu Ye was shaken all over, and his eyes were instantly filled with a chaotic void filled with destructive thunder and violent air currents! In that void, that indescribably huge terrifying shadow made of broken stars and twisted laws seemed to be completely awakened by this drop of blood of a close relative!
The pair of chaotic whirlpool eyes that swallowed up all light suddenly turned in the direction of Chu Ye's consciousness! An indescribable and extremely violent suction force, mixed with overwhelming anger and unwillingness, was like a chain across time and space, suddenly wrapping around Chu Ye's soul and pulling hard!
"Uh-huh!"
Chu Ye in reality let out a painful roar that didn't sound like a human voice! He felt as if his soul was about to be torn out of his body! At the same time, the silent "waste bone" on the back suddenly erupted with unimaginable heat! The blue-black lines under the skin instantly appeared, twisting and spreading like a living creature, emitting a dazzling dark light! An uncontrollable torrent of terrifying power, full of chaos and destruction, burst out from deep in his spine and rushed towards his withered limbs and bones in an instant!
But this power is not meant to destroy him! After it surged wildly inside Chu Ye's body for a week, it suddenly burst out of Chu Ye's body and turned into an invisible, terrifying pressure as heavy as a mountain, instantly covering an area of ​​several feet with Chu Ye as the center! This coercion carries a supreme and terrifying will originating from the origin of life, tyrannically rejecting everything around it! Including the gray-black poisonous mist of death that was rolling and slowly eroding towards the mother and son!
Tsk tsk tsk!
Like a hot iron pressed on an ice cube! The moment that invisible coercion came into contact with the gray-black poisonous mist, the poisonous mist actually made a harsh corrosive sound, rolling and shrinking violently like a living creature! A temporarily safe "vacuum" zone about three feet in diameter was opened around Chu Ye and Liu!
"Pfft!" Chu Ye spurted out a large mouthful of blood again, the color was dark and almost black! Forcibly directing this terrifying force to release, it caused an even more terrifying backlash to his body that was already seriously injured and on the verge of death! He felt that all his internal organs had shifted, and the meridians throughout his body were wailing and bursting! Consciousness is like a candle in the wind, it can be completely extinguished at any time!
But the terrifying will originating from the bones of chaos was like an ancient ferocious beast that was ignited. After opening the safe zone, it did not take it back! It seems to have been manipulated by LiuThe drop of blood of a loved one was completely enraged, and with an almost instinctive and violent intention to protect the loved ones, he suddenly locked onto the rolling abyss of poisonous mist in front of him, which contained the origin of "death" and "corruption"!
"Ho--!"
A chaotic roar filled with endless majesty and rage that only Chu Ye's soul could "hear" exploded in his sea of consciousness!
Immediately afterwards, the terrifying coercion that penetrated the body suddenly turned into an invisible huge "hand" condensed by the violent chaotic airflow. With a terrifying momentum that could crush the stars and tear the void, it fiercely grabbed the abyss of poisonous mist rolling ahead!
Boom! ! !
The entire Black Wind Cliff seemed to be shaken! The thick, ink-like gray-black poisonous mist suddenly exploded like a stagnant pool thrown into a boulder! A huge vortex with a diameter of about ten feet was formed instantly. In the center of the vortex, the rolling poisonous mist was pushed away and annihilated by the overbearing power of chaos! A straight passage leading to the abyss was forcibly torn open by this extremely arrogant "grab"!
The remaining poisonous mist rolled on the inner wall of the passage, making an unwilling hissing sound, but it could not get any closer to the passage! Below the passage, there is a bottomless darkness, exuding a heart-stopping cold atmosphere, and there is also a dull pulsing sound like the heartbeat of a giant beast!
This passage only lasted for a short breath!
The terrifying power that forcibly erupted, repulsed the poisonous mist, and tore open the passage was like a flash in the pan. It exhausted all its power the moment it tore the passage open, and retracted deep into Chu Ye's spine like a tide! The pressure that enveloped the surroundings disappeared instantly, and the three-foot safe zone was quickly swallowed up by the poisonous mist that came back!
Plop!
The huge feeling of emptiness and the more violent backlash caused by the withdrawal of power made Chu Ye unable to hold on any longer. His vision completely went dark, and his body fell forward like a puppet with its strings cut off! And the direction in which he fell was the poisonous mist passage that was forcibly torn open by the power of chaos and was rapidly closing!
"Mother——!"
At the last moment before his consciousness completely fell into darkness, Chu Ye screamed with the last strength of his soul, and his hands instinctively and tightly hugged Liu's cold and limp body next to him!
The next moment, the two figures, like dust swallowed by the huge mouth of darkness, suddenly fell into the abyss passage that was shrinking rapidly and filled with deathly poisonous mist!
Huhuhu——!
The sound of the wind brought about by the rapid fall sounded like a ghost crying! The body was torn apart by the rolling and residual poisonous mist airflow, which was bone-chilling and highly corrosive! My skin felt like needle pricks! Chu Ye had long been unconscious, and only his remaining instinct allowed him to hold his mother tightly in his arms, using his body to protect her as much as possible.
Falling! Endless fall!
Time seems to have lost its meaning. There was only the palpitating feeling of weightlessness and the increasingly dense and suffocating smell of decay.
I don’t know how long it took, it seemed like just a moment, and it seemed like tens of thousands of years had passed.
Bang! Wow!
